entries.def:
ἀγγέλλω (ἄγγελος), 
[in LXX for נגד hi. ;] 
to announce, report: Jhn.4.51 (WHR omit), 20:18 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

ἄγγος, -εος, τό, 
[in LXX for כְּלִי, כְּלוּב ;] 
a vessel: Mat.13.48.†
(AS)

Ἀδμείν (WH, mg., Ἀδάμ), 6, indecl., 
Admin.: Luk.3.33.†
(AS)

ἀθροίζω 
(ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קבץ ;] 
to gather, assemble: Luk.24.33.†
(AS)

ἀμφιέζω, see: ἀμφιάζω.
ἀμφιάζω
(ἀμφί, on both sides: see M, Pr., 100), Hellenistic for ἀμφιέννυμι (cf. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX for לָבַשׁ, etc. ;] 
to clothe: Luk.12.28 (T, -έζει).†
(AS)

ἀμφι-βάλλω (see supr.), 
[in LXX: Hab.1.17 * ;] 
= περιβάλλω, to throw around, as a garment: absol. (MM, VGT, see word), of casting a net: Mrk.1.16 (Rec. βάλλονταν ἀμφίβληστρον).†
SYN.: δίκτυον, σαγήνη. ἀ. is a casting-net, σ. a drag-net, δ. is the more general term - a net of any kind (Tr., Syn., § lxiv). (AS)

ἄμωμον, -ου, τό, 
amomum, a fragrant plant of India (RV, spice): Rev.18.13 
(AS)

ἀνα-πηδάω, -ῶ 
(πηδάω, to leap), [in LXX: 1Sa.20.34 (קוּם) 1Ki.25.10, Est.5.1, To.4 * ;] 
to leap up: Mrk.10.50 (Rec. ἀναστάς) 
(AS)
